description:
Taylor Swift’s The Life of a Showgirl, Kanye West’s delayed BULLY project, Justin Bieber’s Swag & Swag II, and Sabrina Carpenter’s Man’s Best Friend are dominating headlines—BUT what are they doing to your mind? In this video, we break down how today’s biggest artists affect brain chemistry, identity, emotions, and character. Discover how music shapes your habits, rewires your thinking, and influences who you become without even noticing.
